messages.text: New image built and pushed. Pipeline is green. Ready to roll to staging.
Hold. When was the last vulnerability scan on that image? I don't see a scan gate in the pipeline.
Scan runs in stage 3. It passed. I can resend the report if you want.
I want to see it. And the base image—who maintains it? Is it from a trusted registry?
Official node:20-alpine. We've used it for months. No incidents.
No known incidents. That's not the same as compliant. Check for CVEs from the last 7 days. I'll run my own scan.
Running. I'm not trying to skip steps—I just want to ship. Automation should make this faster, not a bottleneck.
Automation that ships vulnerable code is just faster failure. Once the scan clears, I'll sign off. Until then, no staging deploy.
Understood. I'll add a mandatory security gate so you get visibility by default. Sound good?
Good. Then we're aligned. Ping me when the gate is in place.
